data.title: 雷电将军 · 书斋墨夜
data.description: 【成年雷电将军 · 书斋墨夜】深夜天守阁书斋只余纸灯，二十岁以上成年版本的影独自侧倚软垫，轻薄紫色里衣从肩头滑到腰际，裸露胸线与成熟腰腹。她屈起一腿压住散开的古卷，一手支撑身体，另一手在半掩衣摆下缓慢抚慰自己；电光沿长辫与墨迹游走，她咬唇看向镜头，任呼吸扰乱一贯平静。
data.action: 独自侧倚书斋软垫，里衣滑至腰际，一手撑身、一手探入衣摆自抚，紫电沿长辫与古卷游走
data.lighting: warm paper lantern light and soft shadows
data.camera: medium shot, side view, floor cushions and both hands visible
data.promptProse: Adult Ei braces one hand behind her on the cushions, the other beneath her robe, a bent leg holding the scattered decrees. The robe rests at her waist; warm paper-lantern light meets purple arcs along her braid and the scrolls.
data.animaCaption: One hand braces behind her on the cushions while a bent leg holds the scattered decrees in place.
